title: Plenitude — Voice-to-Retention
description: Natural-language access to B2C energy churn scores enriched with contact-centre voice signals. Ask about at-risk customers, churn drivers, and value at risk. All data is synthetic.
instructions: This space serves Plenitude's B2C retail-energy retention team. `churn_scores` has one row per customer with churn_probability (0-1) and risk_band (Low/Medium/High/Critical). `customer_features` holds billing trend, contract, and Gen-AI voice features. `calls_enriched` has per-call sentiment, intent, and churn_signal derived from transcripts. 'At risk' means risk_band IN ('High','Critical'). 'Mentioned switching' means churn_mentions = 1 (customer_features) or churn_signal = 1 (calls_enriched). Value at risk = sum(monthly_bill_eur) * 12 for the selected customers. Region names are Italian (Lombardia, Lazio, ...). Always order at-risk lists by churn_probability descending.
sample_questions: Show the top 20 critical-risk customers ordered by churn probability
Quali clienti in Lombardia con tariffa variabile hanno parlato di cambio fornitore?
What is the churn rate by region, highest first?
How much annual revenue is represented by the High and Critical bands?
Which customers had a negative billing call and a bill increase above 15%?
Average churn probability by contract type and payment method
